rounds.text: Golden Crest Education & Services Ltd trades at an astronomical valuation that is entirely detached from its fundamental reality, evidenced by a staggering P/E ratio of 997x compared to a sector benchmark of just 26.5x [E1, E6]. This extreme multiple is further confirmed by a price-to-book ratio of 16.29x on a book value of ₹ 21.0, towering over the sector benchmark of 2.3x [E2, E7]. This speculative pricing offers zero margin of safety, underlined by a complete lack of income return with a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Furthermore, the underlying operational performance fails to justify this premium, as demonstrated by a weak return on assets of 1.64% which lags behind the sector benchmark of 2.23% [E8]. Compounded long-term sales growth limps along at a meager 2% over 10 years, and the business has been officially flagged for delivering poor sales growth of 11.8% over the past five years [E14, E59]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated recent top-line momentum with a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 27% and year-over-year sales growth of 167% [E17, E63].
